name: seamly2d
description: Lets Claude draw and edit patterns in your running Seamly2D.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Seamly2D program on this computer. In Seamly2D turn on the Claude connection (View > MCP panel) and copy the token from there into this extension's settings. Seamly2D has to be running.

port.title: Port
port.description: Port shown in the MCP panel of Seamly2D (default 47800).

token.title: Token
token.description: Access token from the MCP panel of Seamly2D.
